# Alternative.to

> > Alternative.to is a software discovery platform helping users find alternatives to popular business tools, productivity apps, and SaaS platforms.

The site provides comprehensive comparisons and alternatives for project management tools (Basecamp, Wrike, Asana), marketing automation platforms (HubSpot, ActiveCampaign), ecommerce solutions (Shopify), and various business software categories. It serves as a curated directory for discovering competing and complementary software solutions across enterprise and consumer applications.

## Key Topics

## Project Management & Collaboration

- [Basecamp](https://get.alternative.to/basecamp): Basecamp alternatives for project management & team collaboration
- [Wrike](https://get.alternative.to/wrike): Wrike alternatives like ClickUp, Trello & Asana for project management
- [Station](https://get.alternative.to/station): Station alternatives for unified workspace & app management tools

## Marketing & Ecommerce

- [Shopify](https://get.alternative.to/shopify): Shopify alternatives for ecommerce platforms & website builders
- [HubSpot Marketing Hub](https://get.alternative.to/hubspot-marketing-hub): HubSpot Marketing Hub alternatives for inbound marketing management
- [ActiveCampaign for Marketing](https://get.alternative.to/activecampaign-for-marketing): ActiveCampaign alternatives for marketing automation & email campaigns
- [Linktree](https://get.alternative.to/linktree): Linktree alternatives for link management & social media tools

## Content Creation & Media

- [Clipchamp](https://get.alternative.to/clipchamp): Clipchamp alternatives like Adobe Premiere Pro for video editing
- [Grammarly Business](https://get.alternative.to/grammarly-business): Grammarly Business alternatives for AI writing & business collaboration
- [Kodi](https://get.alternative.to/kodi): Kodi alternatives including Stremio for media streaming & servers

## Security & Productivity Tools

- [KeePass](https://get.alternative.to/keepass): KeePass alternatives including LastPass, 1Password & Bitwarden managers
- [Google Maps](https://get.alternative.to/google-maps): Google Maps alternatives including OpenStreetMap & Waze navigation apps

## Employee Engagement & Learning

- [Nectar](https://get.alternative.to/nectar): Nectar alternatives for employee engagement & team recognition platforms
- [Vantage Circle](https://get.alternative.to/vantage-circle): Vantage Circle alternatives like Nectar & Bonusly for employee rewards
- [Product School](https://get.alternative.to/product-school): Product School alternatives like Udacity for product manager training
